fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 15,000 was withdrawn. The matter was brought to Coimbatore Town PS on 2026-04-15, while the incident was placed on 2026-04-11 at approximately 14:15. The complaint was lodged by Selvam Natarajan (9000000001). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Karthik Shankar, using the number 9000000306. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100038. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records and social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, mobile number, college road, suspect, afternoon, screenshot, transaction record
